# Celestial Location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CelestialLocation`](gmeow-CelestialLocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CelestialLocation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

An astronomical location — a position on the celestial sphere, a solar-system body, a spacecraft, or a deep-sky object. The specific kind is given by [`gmeow:celestialObjectType`](../properties/gmeow-celestialObjectType.md) (a value), not a subclass, so any astronomical object from star to galaxy cluster can be a first-class entity with its own coordinates and external identifiers (SIMBAD, NED, VizieR).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CelestialLocation`](gmeow-CelestialLocation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
